name: LiveCap
detailed_description:
🌟 LiveCap ― AI Subtitles That Bring Your Voice to the World

For streamers, VRChat users, and video creators.

LiveCap is the next-generation AI subtitle tool that instantly converts your words into subtitles and translations, unlocking infinite possibilities for your content. With cutting-edge speech recognition technology, LiveCap breaks down language barriers across streaming, virtual space communication, and video production.

Key Features

  • High-Precision Real-Time AI Subtitles: Instantly display your spoken words as accurate subtitles on screen. Deliver your content to viewers with hearing disabilities or those in sound-restricted environments without compromising the live streaming experience.

  • One-Click Global Connection with Real-Time Translation: Simply speak in your native language and watch it translate into English and many other languages in real-time. Connect seamlessly with viewers worldwide and build a truly global community.

  • Effortless OBS Integration: No complex setup required. Simply add as a source to immediately implement customizable subtitle overlays in your streams.

  • VRChat "Visible Speech" Bubble Feature: Integrates with VRChat's OSC functionality to display your words as real-time pop-ups above your avatar. Enable cross-language communication and create deeper roleplay experiences.

  • SRT Subtitle File Generation for Streamlined Video Editing: Generate SRT format subtitle files from recorded videos or audio files with one click. Dramatically reduce time spent on transcription and subtitle creation, accelerating your creative workflow.

  • Complete Customization Freedom: Freely adjust subtitle and bubble fonts, colors, sizes, display positions, and more to achieve the perfect design for your content.

【For Streamers】 Maximize Viewer Engagement

By integrating LiveCap with OBS, anyone can easily create professional subtitle-enabled streams. Attract international viewers with real-time translation features and respond to comments more smoothly. Enhance each viewer's experience and elevate your channel to the next level.

【For VRChat Users】 Virtual Space Communication Revolution

Visualizing words makes communication infinitely richer. Conversations with international friends, presentations at events—with LiveCap's real-time translation bubbles, there's nothing to fear. Use your words to open new doors in the virtual world.

【For Video Creators】 Liberation from Tedious Subtitle Work

Subtitles are essential for video content, but creating them requires enormous time investment. With LiveCap's SRT file generation feature, you can create accurate subtitle foundations in just a few clicks. Focus your energy on more creative editing work.

⚠️ System Requirements and Important Notes

  • Pre-Purchase Verification: To ensure system compatibility, please test the free demo version before purchasing.

Download the LiveCap demo now and unleash the full power of your words!
